en: The postcard depicts a street scene with old wooden and stone buildings on the left, sunshades hanging from the windows, a few bicyclists riding down a quiet street lined with mature trees, and a notable church with a tall clock tower in the background. The text on the front reads: 'Sundsvall. Tjärnsgatan med Vita Bandets Husmodersskola.' The reverse side lists Swedish publisher 'Axel Eliassons Konstförlag A. B. Stockholm' and has hand-written numbers and a stamp indicating 'EXTRA PRIMA' with the date 18-3-1941.
